subject: Inference Jumpstart — Cross-company panel office hours (confirm time)
body:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@brighthive.com>, Rick Morales <rick@nimble-retail.com>, Emma Liu <emma@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inference Jumpstart — Cross-company panel office hours (confirm time)

Hi everyone,

Hope you’re all well — we’re running a short cross-customer Jumpstart panel next week (high-level product walkthrough + best-practices discussion + live Q&A). The idea is to keep it compact (30–40 minutes) and helpful for teams kicking off inference work.

Proposed times (PT):
- Wed Nov 3, 10:00–10:40 AM PT
- Wed Nov 3, 2:00–2:40 PM PT
- Thu Nov 4, 9:00–9:40 AM PT

Agenda (tentative):
- 0–10m: Quick intros & what each team is trying to accomplish
- 10–25m: Live walkthrough — serving/runtime choices + cost controls
- 25–35m: Q&A and next steps

Attachments: Jumpstart_Panel_Agenda.pdf (short one-pager)

Can you confirm which time works best and whether you prefer a shorter Q&A (10m) or extended (15m)? If you have a specific topic you want covered (security, quantization, routing), drop a line.

Thanks — I’ll consolidate and send a calendar invite with the Meet link once we have consensus.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai


From: Sara Patel <sara@brighthive.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inference Jumpstart — Cross-company panel office hours (confirm time)

Thanks Vanessa — this looks useful. We can join but prefer the earlier PT window (10:00 AM PT on Nov 3). Two quick notes:
1) Could we keep Q&A to 10 minutes? We have a short all-hands directly after.
2) I’ll bring our infra/security lead Mike (cc’d) for the security questions.

Sara
Director of Data Platforms, BrightHive

On Wed, Oct 27, 2026 at 4:12 PM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (original message)


From: Rick Morales <rick@nimble-retail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inference Jumpstart — Cross-company panel office hours (confirm time)

Hey Vanessa — Nov 3 at 10:00 AM PT works for us too. Please note we’ll have three folks on the call from our side. Is there a limit on attendee numbers? Also, could you send an .ics so it goes on our calendars?

Thanks,
Rick Morales
VP Engineering, NimbleRetail

Attachments: calendar-invite.ics (requested)


From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@brighthive.com>, Rick Morales <rick@nimble-retail.com>, Emma Liu <emma@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inference Jumpstart — Cross-company panel office hours (confirm time)

Thanks both — good to hear Nov 3, 10:00 AM PT is mostly preferred. Emma, are you available then? If not, we can fall back to 2:00 PM PT.

Quick clarifications:
- Q&A: we’ll cap at 10 minutes given some folks have tight schedules — we can do a follow-up office hours slot for deeper dives.
- Attendees: no hard limit; just flag if you want to keep it to a single speaker from each company for the live panel. We’ll record and share notes.
- Security: welcome to have Mike join; we’ll plan for a 1–2 minute dedicated note on compliance (SOC2/data isolation) during the walkthrough.

Ben — can you confirm who will lead the product walkthrough? Jordan — would you be okay taking the demo segment and handling live Q&A?

I’ll draft the calendar invite and include the one-pager.

—
Vanessa


From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:58:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inference Jumpstart — Cross-company panel office hours (confirm time)

Thanks Vanessa — Jordan, happy to co-present the product walkthrough with you and handle the short demo (15m). I’ll kick off with a 2-minute context/what-we-see-in-prod and then hand to you for the live steps. I’ll also add the Meet link to the invite.

Jordan — can you confirm you’re good to present 15 minutes and take the Q&A?

Best,
Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference


From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sara Patel <sara@brighthive.com>, Rick Morales <rick@nimble-retail.com>, Emma Liu <emma@cloudforge.io>, Mike Harrison <mike@brighthive.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Inference Jumpstart — Cross-company panel office hours (Nov 3, 10:00 AM PT)

Confirmed — Nov 3, 10:00–10:40 AM PT.

Meet link: https://meet.google.com/xyz-panel-link
Recording will be enabled and we’ll share the deck (Jumpstart_Demo_Deck_v1.pdf).

Please add these items to the invite if you like: a short note on compliance/SOC2 questions, and a link to any pre-read (if you have one). Otherwise, we’ll see you on Tuesday (Nov 3).

—
Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
